title: Lost an eye as a child. Cracked UPSC anyway.
youtubeTitle: Lost an eye as a child. Cracked UPSC anyway.
caption:
Lost an eye as a child. Cracked UPSC anyway.

Irfan Ahmad Lone, the son of a daily-wage labourer from Naidkhai in Bandipora, Kashmir, lost vision in one eye in a childhood accident, with his remaining sight deteriorating over time. He studied at the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities in Dehradun, then went on to Hindu College, Delhi University and Jawaharlal Nehru University. He was working at LIC after clearing the Punjab National Bank's probationary officer exam when he cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 with an All India Rank of 957.
